name: gpt-engineer
description: Open-source project that writes complete codebases from natural-language prompts; SMADP drives a thin runner around the `gpte` CLI for one-shot use.
notes: gpt-engineer writes whole projects, including code that can be executed. The runner.py wrapper invokes gpte with --no_execution + --lite so the sandbox container never runs generated code itself; the transcript captures the planned output.
